results.title: Ukraine weighs legalizing pornography to raise tax revenue and buy drones - Fri, 25 Sep 2026 PST
results.description: For years, Ukraine’s huge but illegal porn industry has operated in the shadows. Law enforcement generally looked the other way, while some officials abused their power to extort bribes from people found to be skirting the law.

results.title: Bittium partners with Safran on advanced tactical communications
results.description: Bittium is a supplier of resilient tactical communications systems, secure mobile communications and software-defined radio technology. The companies will explore how their capabilities can be combined to meet the communications needs of the French armed forces.
